title: Introduce credential annotations and compact generator facade across SDKs (auth/retries/streams) — bump SDKs
author: Ava Mercer
release_notes: Added credential annotations for credential discovery; introduced compact generator (typed streaming) facades across Python/TS/Go SDKs; minor API ergonomics and version bumps for SDKs. Migration notes included.
description: Motivation: reduce auth ceremony and improve streaming ergonomics across SDKs by introducing small, declarative credential annotations and a compact generator facade that provides typed streaming producers/consumers with backoff presets. This PR changes the auth surface in a backwards-compatible way while surfacing clearer retry metadata for observability. What I changed: 1) Python SDK: added redwood.credentials.annotations module, decorator-based credential hints (CredentialHint), a CompactGenerator class that wraps the existing streaming client into a Pythonic async generator with graceful reconnection hooks and a configurable retry preset DSL. Unit tests and examples updated. 2) TypeScript SDK: introduce CredentialAnnotations interface and a light-weight generator wrapper (createCompactStream) that returns an AsyncGenerator with typed payload envelopes, adds retry presets and explicit jitter-aware backoff profiles. 3) Go SDK: add credential tag parsing helpers, a CompactStreamIterator convenience type, and align retry options with the new declarative presets. 4) Cross-SDK: add telemetry fields for credential_source and retry_profile to stream events; updated examples and docs; bump versions (py 0.30.0 -> 0.31.0, ts 1.40.0 -> 1.41.0, go v1.8.0 -> v1.9.0). Migration: default behavior is unchanged; opt-in via new small imports or factory flags. For users who previously built custom stream wrappers, the CompactGenerator offers a drop-in ergonomic alternative and a migration guide is included in sdks/*/MIGRATING.md. Testing: unit tests for each SDK (python/ts/go), integration e2e run against staging inference with synthetic load, linting and type-checks. CI history: first run found a flaky Typescript e2e test (stream ordering) which was fixed by adding a short stabilization window; final CI green. Rollout: merged to main and cut SDK patch releases; followed up with a docs-only PR to amplify examples and a follow-up task to add an observability dashboard for retry_profile (ENG-3540). See linked Linear tickets for detailed acceptance criteria.
